verdict.rationale: Workable's pricing page mentions a 'Custom report builder' and the API exposes raw data (stages, jobs, candidates, offers) that could be used to build such analytics, but there is no direct evidence of built-in dashboards for stage conversion, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, or offer-accept rates per role/team. Missing for 10: documentation of specific analytics/reporting features (time-to-hire metrics, source effectiveness reporting, offer-accept rate tracking, per-role/team breakdowns) and any hands-on or independent confirmation these reports exist and are accurate.
